oa.size.icon.small--oa-size-icon-small16pxIcon at 16 px: a utility icon inline in text or a table heading, or a pixel-fit pillar icon. One color, with no red (R10, DR-67). No topic or atlas symbol is set at this size (DR-136).Untiered
oa.size.icon.medium--oa-size-icon-medium24pxIcon at 24 px: a utility icon beside a control's word, a pixel-fit pillar icon, or one of the 41 topic symbols that read at this size (DR-136). One color, with no red (D2-373, D2-497).Untiered
oa.size.icon.large--oa-size-icon-large48pxIcon at 48 px: the smallest size for a topic or atlas symbol (DR-136), and the smallest that may carry a red accent. A pillar icon under this size sits with its word (R9, DR-67).Untiered
